== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill trainer]]s'''
* [[Zhao Di]] ([[Shing Jea Monastery]])
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this spell as a basic damage skill. They do not take into consideration its conditional effect.

== Notes ==
* [[Glyph of Immolation]] can be used to meet the burning requirement.
* The interruption takes effect before the additional damage.
{{anomaly|Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except [[Blinding Surge]] and [[Sandstorm]]), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate [[packet]].}}

== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after the [[Canthan Heroes|Canthan hero]], [[Teinai]].
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Teinai's Wind/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
